verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Stripe documents an official CLI at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli, so an official CLI exists for the platform Treasury runs on. Nothing in the pack shows that the CLI covers Treasury resources such as financial accounts, outbound payments or transactions, or that it supports AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: evidence that the CLI supports Treasury operations, documented CLI commands and workflows for Treasury, AI or agent-oriented CLI usage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
